35.43089,-82.5015: Edgar W. ('Bill') Nye 1850 1896. Humorist and journalist. Retired to N.C., 1891. Lived at "Buck Shoals," 3 1/2 mi. W. His grave is one mile north.
35.44289,-82.50612: Calvary Church Episcopal. Built 1859. Grave of "Bill" Nye. Memorials to many famous southerners.
35.47284,-82.94095: Rutherford Trace. The expedition led by Gen. Griffith Rutherford against the Cherokee, Sept., 1776, passed here, through Pigeon Gap.
